🆕 New (Posted: October 16, 2026 / Reiwa 8)

We previously notified you of a possible personal information leak following an unauthorized access incident at Arcadia Corporation, which operated systems linked to the Hanno City Emergency Radio Voice Response Service. We have now confirmed that no user personal information from the Hanno City Emergency Radio Voice Response Service was registered in that company's system. We sincerely apologize for the concern and inconvenience this has caused.

Broadcast content continues to be distributed normally through sites, Facebook, and Disaster X (formerly Twitter) managed by Hanno City. Please note that the "Yahoo! Disaster Prevention Alert app" is outside the city's control, so we have no authority over when it resumes service.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/14540.html
summary: ℹ️ Hanno City Emergency Radio Voice Response Service – Security Incident Update
